summary: A SQL injection in the new user-lookup path must be fixed before merge.

prompts.title: Parameterize the user lookup query
prompts.rationale: The name argument is concatenated into SQL, so a crafted name can read or modify arbitrary rows.
prompts.agent_prompt: Rewrite LookupUser in db/user.go to use a parameterized query (db.QueryRow("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?", name)) instead of fmt.Sprintf.
